requirement: A Joomla article created through the Apply door has a real author and keeps a T4 home page up, and Site changes records it under its new id as a create

oracle.ref: PR #1182 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/e2e-full-dev/2026-10-04/R-jo/bugs/J5.8.md (dev e2ef-jo, JA Impact j6: article 76 created_by 0, home page 500 implode() null given; Site changes said article "0" update). Reproduced 11/10/2026 on JA Impact j6 1.0.1 with plugin main ae96119: tasks/evidence/tracy-site-sweep/l4-joomla-article/ (stack: AuthorModel.php:380 <- getAuthor(0) <- T4 Author.php:55 <- ja_impact masonry-layout.php:67; e2e before 10 checks failed, after every check passed).
oracle.invariant: S1: the create's `site_write` row has action `content.create` and target `{kind:'article', id:'76', fields:['title']}`; the audit line keeps action `content.update`. S1: an update, and a create whose answer names no usable id, keep action `content.update` and the call's own id ('5', '0'). S2: every new row has created_by = the first active Super User (never 0), modified_by the same, publish_up set, and valid JSON in attribs/metadata/urls/images; each new article's page and the home page answer 200 ('every check passed').
